translations.👋 <b>Albums bot</b>\n\nCreate albums of: 👋 Albums bot Create albums of photos and videos and share them with a secret code. Got a code from a friend? Just send it to me.
translations.⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try agai: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
Send me an access code to get started.
translations.Album not found or you are not its owner: Album not found or you are not its owner.
translations.Title can't be empty. Try again or /canc: Title can't be empty. Try again or /cancel.
translations.Delete <b>{0}</b> and all its media refe: Delete {0} and all its media references? This can't be undone.
Album closed. Everyone else lost access.
translations.🔓 <b>{0}</b> is open.\n\nAccess code: <c: 🔓 {0} is open. Access code: {1} Link: https://t.me/{2}?start={1} Anyone with the code can watch the album (but not edit it). Closing the album invalidates the code and removes all viewers.
translations.Send me an access code to open an album,: Send me an access code to open an album, or use the menu.
translations.⏳ Too many wrong codes. Please try again: ⏳ Too many wrong codes. Please try again in a few minutes.
❌ Wrong code, or the album is closed.
translations.Only photos and videos can be added. Pre: Only photos and videos can be added. Press Done when finished.
translations.📥 Adding to <b>{0}</b>.\nSend or forward: 📥 Adding to {0}. Send or forward photos and videos – as many as you like. Nothing is saved until you press Done; duplicates are skipped automatically. Media you edit or delete before then is tracked.
translations.To add media, open one of your albums an: To add media, open one of your albums and press ➕ Add media.
translations.\n🔒 Closed – only you can see it: 🔒 Closed – only you can see it
translations.Type the numbers of the items to delete,: Type the numbers of the items to delete, e.g. 5, 1 2 3 or 1-3. Numbers are permanent — deleting items never renumbers the others. You will see a preview first and can cancel before anything is deleted. Don't know the numbers? Open the view with numbers.
translations.ℹ️ {0} number(s) were not found and igno: ℹ️ {0} number(s) were not found and ignored.
translations.🗑 <b>Preview</b> – {0}\nSelected {1}, sh: 🗑 Preview – {0} Selected {1}, showing {2}–{3}. The numbers under the pictures are listed in picture order. Tap a number to keep it (↩) or to delete it again (🗑). Type other numbers to replace the selection. Will be deleted: {4} of {1}
translations.⚠️ {0} item(s) could not be shown (they: ⚠️ {0} item(s) could not be shown (they can still be deleted).
translations.This preview has expired. Start again fr: This preview has expired. Start again from 🗑 Remove media.
translations.\nThe numbers under the pictures are lis: The numbers under the pictures are listed in the same order as the pictures (left to right, top to bottom). Numbers never change.
translations.\n🗑 Type the number(s) to delete, e.g. <: 🗑 Type the number(s) to delete, e.g. 12, 12 15 18 or 12-15.
translations.⚠️ No items with those numbers (already: ⚠️ No items with those numbers (already deleted or never existed).
